title: Mexican Street Corn (Elote)
description: Charred corn on the cob slathered with a lime-spiked mayo and crema, rolled in cotija and dusted with chili powder.

image.alt: Grilled corn on the cob with crema, cotija, chili and lime

steps.text: Heat the grill or broiler to high. Cook the corn, turning every couple of minutes, until tender and charred in spots, {time 10-12 min}.
Stir the mayonnaise, sour cream, lime zest and garlic together.
Brush the hot corn all over with the mayo mixture, then roll or sprinkle it in the cheese. Dust with chili powder and cilantro and serve with lime wedges.

notes: For a bowl version (esquites), char frozen corn kernels in a hot skillet and toss with the same toppings.
